claims.statement: Every example exposes its stable surface identity and lifecycle state through the component's machine-readable attributes.
Loading examples expose aria-busy=true on the semantic surface.
Loading, partial, and error examples expose a polite status announcement when a status message is supplied.

component.purpose: Expose the lifecycle of an independently meaningful rendered region without imposing layout or visual presentation.
component.title: Experience Surface

elements.description: The polite lifecycle announcement when present.

states.description: The surface is waiting for required work and announces progress.
The surface has usable primary content.
The surface completed successfully with no applicable content.
The primary task remains usable while supporting data is unavailable.
The surface reached a terminal failure and announces it accessibly.
The surface has no asynchronous lifecycle requirement.
